integrity: The proof is symbolic and dimension-theoretic. The critical source ingredients were checked in the full text of arXiv:2610.02020v1, and a highly relevant predecessor was inspected in full-text PDF form. A bundled exact-arithmetic enumeration is supplementary and is not used as evidence for the universal theorem.
limitations: The connected-graph criterion is proved for nondegenerate quadrangles only. Degenerate quadrangles may require tangency conditions at repeated vertices. The six-incidence entanglement certificate is not claimed globally minimal, and the bibliographic search was targeted rather than exhaustive.
title: Optimal spanning-tree midpoint tests for a quadrangle conic net
